notes: Crouched, fallen and recovering body bounds are never fitted to standing height. Each body uses only its manually inspected head ruler.
Seven poses have targeted image-generation arm corrections to match approved guard handedness. Original raw sources are retained separately.
Recover rise was reframed once to repair a clipped sandal. The final source is unclipped.
Both the rigid weapon and body retain full affine transforms. No weapon per-frame scaling.
Hurt impact uses rear grip at 45% of shaft instead of 22%, keeping both hands on the shaft and the fixed-length spear fully within canvas.
Idle and stunned can transition to the shared approved guard direction; front guide grip may slide.
Weapon is released in down fall and laid beside body in down ground and recover roll. Recover kneel reacquires the spear.
GIF and MP4 are opaque-background viewing proxies. Only formal PNGs and layer PNGs carry production RGBA.
100 fps MP4 repeats held imagery for exact 10 ms timing; those repeated video samples are not claimed as extra animation poses.
Each non-loop action holds its final formal frame until runtime changes state. No runtime code or Git changes are included.
